# lib/bus module

I2C and SPI MEM register access for 8-bit PICs. This page is the reference for the `lib/bus` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family. Build it with the repository build driver, or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

| Family | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|
| PIC16F87XA | `bus` | [`lib/bus/examples/example_bus.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/bus/examples/example_bus.c) |
| PIC16F88X | `bus` | [`lib/bus/examples/example_bus.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/bus/examples/example_bus.c) |
| PIC18Fxx5x | `bus` | [`lib/bus/examples/example_bus.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/bus/examples/example_bus.c) |

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/bus` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/bus). This page does not restate it. This is a documentation gap: the manifest carries no function list to generate a table from.

## Limits

- Not built for 18F2455, 18F2550. Reason: RAM: does not fit on this smaller part.
- Not built for 16F872. Reason: flash: bus example does not fit 2K CODE (XC8 error 1347).
- Not built for 16F870, 16F871. Reason: no SSP peripheral on this cut-down.
